Serilog._comment: Defaults wired by UseCardscapeSerilog(). The MCP server is a stdio host; the OTel sink only attaches when Otel:EndpointUrl is set so the process can stay quiet when no collector is around.

Cardscape._comment: Operator-tunable subsystems. The MCP server uses the same AddCardscapeInfrastructure composition as the API, so the rate-limiter backend switch applies here too. The 2FA-pending-token store is API-only and is not consulted by MCP tools. See docs/operations/06-configurable-subsystems.md.

Redis._comment: Required only when at least one subsystem sets its Backend to 'Redis'.
